title: vibemix IPC messages
description: Source-of-truth JSON Schema for ipc.* messages exchanged between the Tauri shell (TypeScript webview) and the Python sidecar over the existing 127.0.0.1:8765 ws_bus (Phase 4). Phase 11 Wave 0 freezes this contract before any sidecar packaging, Tauri shell, or wizard UI work begins. Drift between Python (jsonschema) and TS (ajv) is caught by scripts/check_ipc_schema.py (count parity + per-dataclass roundtrip) and tauri/ui's `npm run check:ipc` (codegen + tsc --noEmit). Honors D-Area-1.3 (schema sync) and D-Area-1.1 (ipc.* namespace on existing ws_bus port 8765). Closed payloads (additionalProperties: false) on every definition per RESEARCH Pitfall 10.

IpcBoot.$comment: Sidecar → shell. First message after the sidecar opens its ws_bus listener. RESEARCH §IPC Schema. D-Area-1.1.

StatusTick.$comment: Sidecar → shell @ ~1Hz. Status-bar badges for the live UI surface. D-Area-4.3 locks four required health fields plus optional voice/capture/controller diagnostics — no extra fields tolerated; tests assert additionalProperties: false blocks any drift. UX-11 requirement.

PermissionCheck.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Requests current OS permission state for a given capability. D-Area-2.1 (Step 1 permissions).

PermissionState.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Resolved OS permission state for the queried capability. D-Area-2.1 — drives the auto-advance behavior after the user returns from Settings.

CalibrationListDevices.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Wizard Step 2 entry — request a fresh sounddevice.query_devices() snapshot. D-Area-2.2.

CalibrationDeviceList.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Output device enumeration + BlackHole presence flag. D-Area-4.1 (BlackHole detection accepts 2ch / 16ch / 64ch variants).

CalibrationProbeAudio.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Auto-play 1kHz sine + programmatic sample-rate assertion. D-Area-2.2 — both audible-confirmed and programmatic-pass must hold to advance the wizard.

CalibrationAudioResult.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Probe outcome: playback + sample-rate + actual rate + error. D-Area-2.2. actual_rate is nullable so the sidecar can report null on error paths (e.g. device-open failure before sample-rate negotiation).

CalibrationUserHeardTone.$comment: Shell → sidecar. The user's Yes/Retry response to the 1kHz tone playback. D-Area-2.2.

CalibrationStartMidiListen.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Begin controller-probe MIDI listener with a countdown timeout (Step 3). D-Area-2.3.

CalibrationMidiEvent.$comment: Sidecar → shell. First MIDI message decoded by the controller-probe listener. control_label is the human-readable mapping label (e.g. 'Deck A Play') or the raw bytes when no mapping matches. D-Area-2.3.

CalibrationMidiTimeout.$comment: Sidecar → shell. 10-second listen window expired without input — shell falls back to generic-mapping path. D-Area-2.3.

CalibrationListWindows.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Wave-4 window-picker entry — request running windows for DJ-app hint matching. OS-specific enumeration lives in the Python platform layer (Quartz on macOS / EnumWindows on Windows per Phase 3+7+8 surfaces). D-Area-3.2.

CalibrationWindowList.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Enumerated windows with DJ-app hint resolution (djay, rekordbox, serato, traktor, virtualdj, or null when no match). D-Area-3.2 — non-DJ apps are warned-then-allowed.

CalibrationSmokeTest.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Wizard-exit smoke test — single AI greeting through the cascade (LLM → TTS → audio). Verifies the entire chain end-to-end. D-Area-2.4 (wizard exit).

CalibrationSmokeTestStarted.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Smoke-test generation started (LLM call kicked off). UI shows a transient 'speaking…' indicator.

CalibrationSmokeTestDone.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Smoke-test completion + transcript (for verifier visibility per Phase 16). D-Area-2.4.

WizardStart.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Re-runnable wizard entry point — Settings panel (Phase 12) wires this. D-Area-3.4.

WizardDone.$comment: Shell → sidecar. Wizard completion — final state passed to first_run_completed write. D-Area-3.1.

WizardSetSkill.$comment: Shell -> sidecar. Onboarding skill-level step. Fire-and-forget; sidecar persists config.json extra.skill so the next cold boot seeds VIBEMIX_SKILL_LEVEL.

SessionSnapshot.$comment: Phase 12 — Sidecar → shell @ 30Hz. Live session state snapshot driving meters, transcript, phase tape, drop chip, MIDI event ribbon. UX-08.

SessionMute.$comment: Phase 12 — Bidirectional. Shell sends {toggle: true} to mute mid-utterance (drains PlaybackQueue). Sidecar acks with {muted: <newState>}. Same type, asymmetric payloads. UX-07.

SessionCitation.$comment: Phase 20 — Sidecar to shell. Live anti-slop telemetry: per-session slop_ratio (cumulative stripped/total), 15s rolling stripped_rate, the last unverified response text (when bypass fires), and the live bypass_active flag. UX-Settings-Diagnostics surface for the citation linter. GROUND-06.

SessionSetMode.$comment: Phase 97 (ONBOARD-01) — Shell → sidecar. User picked a mode in the picker on the main session window. The shell flips data-active locally (optimistic repaint per CLAUDE.md rule) BEFORE this envelope is sent; the sidecar persists via ConfigStore.extra under 'session.mode' so the next launch boots into the last-picked mode. No ack is emitted — the optimistic repaint is authoritative; ipc.settings.state may surface the mode on its next snapshot so cold-boot reads disk.

SessionStart.$comment: SHIP-WIRE START-gate. Shell -> sidecar. The user pressed Start on the live-session deck; the co-host goes from armed (idle, no reactions) to running. The shell flips data-runstate='running' optimistically (CLAUDE.md repaint rule) BEFORE this envelope is sent; no ack, the backend reflects run-state on its next ipc.session.snapshot. BACKEND-BOOT lane implements the handler register_handler('ipc.session.start', _on_session_start) wiring the live-session lifecycle (model load + silent pre-warm + capture start) in __main__.py; that island is theirs, not the frontend lane's.

SessionStop.$comment: SHIP-WIRE START-gate. Shell -> sidecar. The user pressed Stop; the co-host returns to armed (idle). The shell flips data-runstate='armed' optimistically BEFORE this envelope; no ack. BACKEND-BOOT lane implements register_handler('ipc.session.stop', _on_session_stop) ending capture and parking/unloading the model in __main__.py; theirs, not the frontend lane's.

SettingsSet.$comment: Phase 12 — Shell → sidecar. Hot-reload a single setting. UX-06, UX-09, UX-10.

field.$comment: Phase 93 (EXEMPLAR-04) — learn.headphone_device_index is integer >= 0 OR null (system default).

SettingsSetBrain.$comment: 2026-06-04 DEMOCRATIZATION-1 — Shell → sidecar. Persist the live-co-host brain path so a non-dev reaches the model WITHOUT hand-editing .env. mode persists to ConfigStore.llm_mode; gemini_api_key (direct only, when present) is written by the BACKEND to app_data_dir()/.env (or keychain) and is NEVER echoed back, NEVER logged, NEVER committed. The ack is ipc.settings.brain_ack (no secret). The user restarts the sidecar to pick up the new key/mode.

gemini_api_key.$comment: Present ONLY for mode=direct when the user typed a new key. null/omitted = keep existing key, persist mode only. The backend treats empty string as no-change.

SettingsBrainAck.$comment: 2026-06-04 DEMOCRATIZATION-1 — Sidecar → shell ack for ipc.settings.set_brain. Carries NO secret — key_set is a boolean, never the key value. restart_required is always true today (the brain path is read at boot; there is no mid-session model-client hot-swap).

SettingsGet.$comment: Phase 12 — Shell → sidecar. Request full settings snapshot.

SettingsState.$comment: Phase 12 — Sidecar → shell. Full settings snapshot — emitted on boot, on ipc.settings.get, and after any ipc.settings.set ack. Optional extra-backed settings round-trip through this snapshot; required list stays at the always-emitted fields so existing emit paths and tests stay green.

mood.$comment: IN-03 in 14-REVIEW.md — optional. Null means the sidecar has no MusicState reference (boot path before audio engine starts). enum mirrors the MascotMood literal in the TS client.

click_through.$comment: IN-03 in 14-REVIEW.md — optional. Null means the field is absent from ConfigStore.extra (pre-Plan 13-05 disk state).

skill.$comment: 2026-05-25 — optional persona level (beginner/intermediate/pro). Null means the field is absent from ConfigStore.extra (pre-skill-wiring disk state). enum mirrors prompts.matrix.build_system_instruction skill arg + the deckSkillToWire map in SessionLayout.ts.

lens.$comment: Phase 79 LENS-02 - optional shared persona lens. Null means the field is absent from ConfigStore.extra and each surface uses its own cold-path default.

learn.headphone_device_index.$comment: Phase 93 Plan 03 (EXEMPLAR-04) — optional headphone output device index for tutor exemplar playback (ExemplarPlayer.sd.OutputStream device kwarg). Null = system default (user did NOT pick a device); int >= 0 = explicit ``sounddevice`` device index. Persisted via ConfigStore.extra (mirrors the mascot.*/recording.* pattern — no config-store schema bump).

session.mode.$comment: Phase 97 (ONBOARD-01) — optional top-level mode picker value (cohost/learn/build/debrief). Null means the user has not picked a mode yet — the renderer defaults to 'cohost' in that case (matches makeDefault() in session/state.ts). Persisted via ConfigStore.extra under 'session.mode' (same path as mascot.*/recording.*); cold-boot reads this so the picker lights the last-picked segment without UI flicker.

StatusRecheck.$comment: Phase 12 — Shell → sidecar. One-shot recheck of a component's health; sidecar then emits a fresh ipc.status.tick. UX-11.

IpcError.$comment: Phase 12 — Sidecar → shell. Emitted when an inbound message fails schema validation or a handler raises. Never crashes the loop. UX-08 reliability.

MascotMoodChange.$comment: Phase 13-05 — Sidecar → shell + mascot overlay. Emitted the moment SettingsApplier flips MusicState.mood + ConfigStore.mood. Carries the previous mood so the renderer (Plan 13-04) can pick the right particle/puff mask + the AT timestamp for the events.jsonl recorder.

RecordingsList.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Shell → sidecar. Request a snapshot of all on-disk recording sessions. Empty payload; the response is RecordingsListResult. Consumed by SettingsDrawer's Recording group on drawer open.

RecordingsListResult.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Sidecar → shell. Response to RecordingsList. `sessions` is an array of RecordingSummary objects (one per <YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>/ directory under the recordings root). `bytes_total` is the sum of all session sizes — UI renders 'Recordings: N sessions, X.Y GB used'. session_dir on each summary MUST match the V12 path-traversal regex ^[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}$ (Phase 15-RESEARCH Security Domain).

RecordingsDelete.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Shell → sidecar. Delete a single recording directory after the confirmDialog 'This cannot be undone.' prompt. session_dir is the basename (NOT a path) and MUST match ^[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}$ — V12 path-traversal gate enforced at the schema (Phase 15-RESEARCH Security Domain). Sidecar replies with RecordingsDeleteAck.

RecordingsDeleteAck.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Sidecar → shell. Acknowledgment for RecordingsDelete. ok=true means shutil.rmtree completed; ok=false carries a short error string for the toast/snackbar surface. session_dir echoes back so the UI can match the ack to the row that initiated the delete (the row stays in 'deleting…' state until the ack arrives).

RecordingsUsage.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Sidecar → shell, push. Emitted after RetentionSweep runs (boot, retention-days change, session close) so the SettingsDrawer's 'Recordings: N sessions, X.Y GB used' line updates without polling. Same shape as the aggregate fields on RecordingsListResult but without the per-session detail array.

RecordingsEvents.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Shell → sidecar. Fetch the full events.jsonl record list for a single session (used by the row-expanded transcript overlay). session_dir MUST match the V12 path-traversal regex — same gate as RecordingsDelete. Response: RecordingsEventsResult.

RecordingsEventsResult.$comment: Phase 15-01 — Sidecar → shell. events.jsonl record list for one session. Each per-event object REQUIRES `t` (seconds since session start, non-negative) + `kind` (string from the POC vocabulary: session_start, trigger, trigger_fired, ai_text, controller_move, midi_event, turn_error, session_error, …). Per-kind additional fields (e.g. `text` on ai_text, `reason` on trigger, `control` on controller_move) are intentionally NOT enumerated — additionalProperties: true keeps the wire shape open-extensible. The UI renders bold/dim per kind (UI-SPEC §Row expanded state).

SessionOverlayHighlight.$comment: Phase 24-02 — Sidecar → shell. Fired when the LLM emits a valid [screen:<element_id>] citation AND the citation linter's action is 'emit'. The shell invokes Rust `show_overlay_highlight` which queries djay Pro AX (or window-rect fallback) for the element bounds and opens a transparent + click-through WebviewWindow rendering an amber ring for duration_ms. OVERLAY-01.

SessionCohostReaction.$comment: Phase 44-03 / LAUNCH-02 — Sidecar → shell. Fired once per AI reaction the DJCoHostAgent emits to the user (post citation-linter, post slop-filter). Carries reaction text + LLM event tag + the parsed structured citation_strip. The live session UI renders a chip strip below the matching transcript line; clicking a chip invokes open_debrief_window with a deep_link payload pointing at the chip's timestamp. citation_strip is an empty array (NEVER null) when no atom resolves to a registry observation — keeps the TS consumer type stable.

DebriefSessionLoaded.$comment: Phase 25/29 — DEBRIEF window. Sidecar → shell. Fired once when the DEBRIEF sidecar opens a session_dir; carries session metadata so the renderer can populate the top banner.

DebriefChapterList.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Sidecar → shell. Chapter list emitted after debrief.chapters.derive_chapters runs. Renderer mounts ChapterList + Timeline regions.

DebriefNearMiss.$comment: Learn Revolution A5 — DEBRIEF Last Night, Heard. Sidecar → shell. Carries a resolver-backed near-miss/gap/quiet payload and points the renderer at input.wav via the existing recordings asset scope.

DebriefTldrAudio.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Sidecar → shell. Points to the on-disk debrief_tldr.mp3; renderer fetches via asset://. MP3-only per P81; duration_s is 60-90s per DEBRIEF-04.

DebriefDrills.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Sidecar → shell. Exactly 3 SBI/STAR-AR drills per DEBRIEF-06. Each drill carries situation/behavior/impact/action_recommended + a canonical [ev:*]/[track:*]/[mix:*] citation tag.

DebriefCitationTooltipReq.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Renderer → sidecar. Ask the sidecar to look up the evidence behind a citation tag from the in-memory EvidenceRegistry snapshot.

DebriefCitationTooltip.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Sidecar → renderer. Resolved evidence behind a citation tag. found=false means the snapshot didn't have it within ±2.0s tolerance (Phase 20 debrief band).

DebriefError.$comment: Phase 29 Plan 29-03 — DEBRIEF v2.1 additive (P82 lock). Sidecar → renderer. Error envelope. reason is allowlisted; message is developer-readable detail. Renderer maps reason to user-facing copy in error-banner.ts.

LibraryImport.$comment: Plan 28-06 — renderer to sidecar. Start a library import from a folder or Rekordbox XML path.

LibraryImportProgress.$comment: Plan 28-06 — sidecar to renderer. Per-track or final library import progress.

LibraryImportCancel.$comment: Plan 28-06 — renderer to sidecar. Request cancellation of the in-flight library import.

LibraryStalenessNudge.$comment: Plan 28-07 — sidecar to renderer. 30-day staleness nudge to re-import.

LibraryStalenessAction.$comment: Plan 28-07 — renderer to sidecar. User dismissed or snoozed the nudge.

ProfileSetConsent.$comment: Phase 32 — Shell → sidecar. Persists profile_consent to ~/.config/vibemix/state.json. Default-OFF (PROFILE-05); sidecar honors whatever boolean arrives. Sidecar replies with ProfileConsentState.

ProfileConsentState.$comment: Phase 32 — Sidecar → shell. Reflects current profile_consent from disk.

ProfileView.$comment: Phase 32 — Shell → sidecar. Empty payload; reply is ProfileViewResult with the on-disk profile + byte count + consent state.

ProfileViewResult.$comment: Phase 32 — Sidecar → shell. Snapshot of ~/.config/vibemix/profile.json + UTF-8 byte length + consent flag. profile is null when absent OR when consent is off. Settings → Profile panel reads this once on open.

ProfileRegenerate.$comment: Phase 32 — Shell → sidecar. Empty payload; rebuilds profile from current EvidenceRegistry snapshot. Reply is ProfileRegenerateResult.

ProfileRegenerateResult.$comment: Phase 32 — Sidecar → shell. ok=true means a new profile was built AND saved; ok=false carries a short reason (consent_off / insufficient_evidence / other).

ProfileDelete.$comment: Phase 32 — Shell → sidecar. Empty payload; unlinks ~/.config/vibemix/profile.json. Reply is ProfileDeleteAck.

ProfileDeleteAck.$comment: Phase 32 — Sidecar → shell. ok=true means the file was deleted; ok=false with error='not_found' means the file did not exist (UI surfaces a 'no profile' state).

LearnControllerDetected.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Single fire per MIDI port-bind / unbind event. Phase 91 RENDER-01 / RENDER-07.

LearnMidiPosition.$comment: Sidecar → shell. 30 Hz delta-suppressed controller position snapshot. Phase 91 RENDER-02. Keys in 'positions' follow '<field>:<deck>' (deck-bound) or bare '<field>' (master-section) convention; values 0..127 for CC controls, 0/1 for booleans.

LearnStartCourse.$comment: Shell → sidecar. User picked a course in the HUD. Phase 92 LESSON-02.

LearnStartLesson.$comment: Shell → sidecar. User skipped into a specific lesson. Phase 92 LESSON-02.

LearnCompleteLesson.$comment: Bidirectional. User skip OR system advance. Phase 92 LESSON-02 / LESSON-04.

LearnLessonLoaded.$comment: Sidecar → shell. A lesson is loaded; HUD metadata. Phase 92 LESSON-02.

LearnHighlight.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Glow a control on the rendered SVG. Phase 92 RENDER-04. Dual-channel cue (cue_color + cue_shape) for color-blind a11y. ≤16ms paint budget pinned by tauri/ui/tests/learn/highlight-paint.test.ts.

LearnAdvance.$comment: Bidirectional. Tutor-confirms-MIDI OR user skip. Phase 92 LESSON-04.

LearnTeachingFocus.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Particle-organism focus trigger paired with a highlight. NOT an overload of ipc.learn.highlight (16ms SVG paint budget). phase=focus dissolves+streams the mascot organism to the control; phase=reform pulls it home on advance. band carries the EQ band (low/mid/hi) or null for non-EQ controls. Organism visual grounding — fires ONLY on a real teaching event.

LearnControlRect.$comment: Learn window → mascot window. Screen-space center of a highlighted control's getBoundingClientRect, relayed over the ws bus so the separate mascot webview can convert screen→world and aim the focus stream. Stored in the mascot's controlRectRegistry keyed control_id:deck.

LearnAck.$comment: Shell → sidecar. User touched physical control OR clicked SVG. Phase 92 LESSON-04. The sidecar replies with advance if action_matches.

LearnTutorSpeak.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Tutor narration. text comes from JSON fixture (NEVER LLM-generated). citations[] is empty in P92 — P93+ populates with [exemplar:<id>] when exemplar engine ships. Phase 92 TONE-02 / LESSON-05.

LearnLiveGrade.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Deterministic beatmatch grade tick for the Learn lock-meter HUD.

LearnWaveformReady.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Compact two-deck Learn practice waveform peaks.

LearnPlayheadTick.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Owned-deck playhead and current BPM tick for Learn practice.

LearnTeachingLoop.$comment: Optional backstage observe → decide → teach → verify → adapt metadata for LearnTutorSpeak. Ignored by the calm frontstage, used by proof/dev tooling.

LearnExemplarPlay.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Exemplar audio playback STARTED. SHAPE ONLY in P92 — engine in P93. Phase 92 LESSON-02 (shape).

LearnExemplarStop.$comment: Sidecar → shell. Exemplar audio playback ENDED. SHAPE ONLY in P92 — engine in P93.

LearnProgressState.$comment: Bidirectional. action='snapshot' (push from sidecar) or action='reset' (request from shell) or action='reset_ack' (sidecar confirms reset). Phase 92 LESSON-03.

skill_wall.$comment: v11.0 Earned Wall. IPC-only derived block (SkillTree.compute), never persisted. Per-skill Competent/Mastered stage + the SURF-01 what_remains advance line the webview renders. Phase 104.

next_practice_mission.$comment: IPC-only derived Learn booth mission. Deterministic next move built from curriculum/progress/skill wall; never persisted to learn-progress.json.
